purpose: Node-note order review against the saved HDBv2 hierarchy: how saved PPv10 scores order each node's notes, and where saved coverage cannot order a node at all. The consumer of prominence is node-note ordering (plan task 27); nothing here is judged outside that.
limits_note: masks and node membership unchanged · how one note's several masks in a node combine is undecided (no sum/max/average; task 27) · checks are not an accuracy rate · PPv10 not production-frozen; registry still freezes PPv2

preserved_disagreements.text: Predeclared as a major focus (70-89); the score of 58 is secondary. The post also covers meat preparation and animal feed, so the boundary is arguable, and the mask is in no node, so no node-note order is affected yet. Do not hide this, and do not add a prompt rule just to raise it.

open_questions: Eight scored masks belong to no node (task 24): their scores order nothing until membership recovery places them.
Only S9c440e7f47 has complete saved scores. Comparable saved scores for each node's remaining masks are the missing evidence for the actual ordering decision.
One note with several masks in one node is present (Sbb8511308a, S68ce4fd21f): how those combine is undecided (task 27) and must not be smuggled in as sum, max, or average.

nodes.commentary: Two bare coffee tokens in hashtag-style posts: a mostly-hashtag second-coffee post and an animal-ethics quotation with a stray Coffee hashtag. Both masks are scored, so this is the only node with a complete saved order. Is the second-coffee post correctly ahead of the quotation post?

A coffee node over three posts: More coffee in cool places; Iced coffee, served in ice; and Is there coffee for me? The first post contributes two overlapping masks here and the dog-coffee post is unscored, so the full order needs two more scores and the undecided multi-mask rule. The two scored posts tie at 95; no order between them was predeclared.

A post-Christmas node: a Santa-didn't-show post, an after-Christmas slowdown post, a printing-Christmas-cards diary, and the daily update's today-is-a-gift closing. Only that last mask is scored, so saved scores cannot order this node at all.
